_comment: Cards that exist only for the your-turn delay test (tests/unit/test_delay_your_turn.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. The pair is the whole point: `t_delay_any_end_step` is the delay the engine could always write -- 'at the beginning of the next end step' -- and `t_delay_your_end_step` is the same delay with `your_turn`, which is 'at the beginning of *your* next end step'. Cast at instant speed on an opponent's turn the two fire a full turn apart, and with only one of them in the pool there was nothing to tell them apart.

cards.name: Test Delay Any End Step
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of the next end step, you gain 3 life.

spell_effects.text: At the beginning of the next end step, you gain 3 life.

cards.name: Test Delay Your End Step
